messages.content: 四個圓的總周長是多少，其中第一個圓的半徑為5公分，第二個圓的半徑為10公分，第三個圓的半徑為15公分，第四個圓的半徑為20公分？

function.name: calculate_circumference
function.description: Calculates the circumference of a circle with a given radius. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: The radius of the circle in the unit given.

message.content:
**計算方式**

每顆圓的周長公式是  
\[
C \;=\; 2\,\pi r
\]

| 圓 | 半徑 \(r\)（cm） | 周長 \(C\) |
|---|-----------------|------------|
| 第一圈 | 5 | \(2\pi\times5 = 10\pi \approx 31.42\;\text{cm}\) |
| 第二圈 | 10 | \(2\pi\times10 = 20\pi \approx 62.83\;\text{cm}\) |
| 第三圈 | 15 | \(2\pi\times15 = 30\pi \approx 94.25\;\text{cm}\) |
| 第四圈 | 20 | \(2\pi\times20 = 40\pi \approx 125.66\;\text{cm}\) |

將四者相加：

\[
\begin{aligned}
C_{\text{total}}
&= 10\pi + 20\pi + 30\pi + 40\pi\\[4pt]
&= (10+20+30+40)\,\pi \\[4pt]
&= 100\,\pi \\
&\approx 314.16\;\text{cm}.
\end{aligned}
\]

---

### 結論
四個圓的總周長約 **\(314.16\;\text{厘米}\)**。如果保留符號形式，可寫成 **\(100\pi\;\text{cm}\)**。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "What is the total circumference of four circles where first has radius 5 cm, second 10 cm, third 15 cm, fourth 20 cm?" We need to compute each circumference and sum them.

Circumference formula C=2πr. So:

C1 = 2 * π * 5 = 10π ≈ 31.4159 cm
C2 = 2*π*10 = 20π ≈ 62.8318 cm
C3 = 2*π*15 = 30π ≈94.2477 cm
C4 = 2*π*20 =40π≈125.6637 cm

Sum = (10+20+30+40)π =100π ≈314.159265 cm.
